title: reminders/en.json
description: The texts of map reminders in English, in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations; the other languages' files have their own schema. Each text is one line in which {variable} stands for a value the reminder fills in, each text with its own variables: it uses every one of them and no other; {{ and }} are literal braces. NERV's backend takes these files when it is released, checking them again. English has every text but the QQ bot's (qq_*), which only Simplified Chinese has: a text another language leaves out shows in English.

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {map}; every other brace is doubled

map.description: The map's line when the language has no name for it; {map}: the raw map name

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {map}, {name}; every other brace is doubled

map_with_name.description: The map's line with its name in the language; {map}: the raw map name, {name}: its name

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {players}, {capacity}; every other brace is doubled

players.description: The line of the server's current players; {players}: the players, bots not counted, {capacity}: the server's human capacity, the most players who are not bots it takes, the denominator the server list shows (31 / 32 on EXG PVE模式 #1, whose capacity of 61 holds 29 bots)

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {players}; every other brace is doubled

players_without_capacity.description: The same line for a server whose capacity its source does not tell; {players}: the players

allOf.description: Uses no variable but {server}; every other brace is doubled

server.description: The server's line; {server}: its name as the server list shows it in the language, with the community's short name before it (unless the name begins with the community's name) and the server's labels after it, each after ' · ', e.g. EXG 僵尸逃跑 #5 · 热门; the text adds no labels or separator of its own

allOf.description: Uses no variable; every brace is doubled

title.description: The reminder's title, e.g. 换图通知
